name: Sandbox VT
old_description: The SANDBOX is a no-bounds creators space that promotes sustainable action through creativity, community and curated experiences based in the south end of Burlington, VT.
about:
Sandbox VT operates from the south end of Burlington, Vermont, where it functions as a repair and circular services partner for clothing and gear. The company describes itself as a no‑bounds creators space promoting sustainable action through creativity and community. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed, and ownership structure has not been specified.

The shop provides expert repair, restoration, and alteration services for individuals, including clothing repair, technical outerwear and gear repair, backpack repair, zipper replacement, and mail‑in options. For business clients it runs warranty and repair programs, offers overflow repair capacity, technical sewing, product restoration, waterproofing, returns refurbishment, and small‑batch production that upcycles brand sample fabric into unique product runs. A curated selection of gently pre‑loved apparel is also sold monthly.

Customers range from individual consumers to outdoor brands, retailers, and designers who prioritize durability and circularity. The company cites work with outdoor brands and retailers needing warranty support, as well as designers seeking small‑batch upcycled collections. Bridal and formalwear alterations represent an additional service line.

Sandbox VT states its mission is to make repair the first choice, extending product life through expert craft and circular solutions. It emphasizes community values, sustainable impact, and keeping better products in use longer as its guiding principles.

name: Sander's Sew-N-Vac + The Fabric Bin
about:
Sander's Sew-N-Vac + The Fabric Bin operates in Aberdeen, South Dakota. The business traces its roots to 1945 when Al Sander opened Sander's Sew-N-Vac to sell Electrolux vacuums. In 1976 his son Greg Sander purchased the downtown main‑street store and continued the family proprietorship.

In the late 1990s and early 2000s Greg expanded into fabric retail, opening The Fabric Bin. Today the store carries hundreds of bolts of fabric alongside notions, pre‑cut kits, and sewing supplies. The shop also still sells vacuums and offers in‑store sewing classes, weekly live shopping events, and 0% interest financing through Synchrony. Day‑to‑day operations are managed by Shirelle Stadel, a ten‑year employee, with assistant manager Alesha Stadel supporting projects and live shows.

The business serves individual sewers, quilters, and crafters both locally and through its online store. Customers range from hobbyists seeking specific fabrics to beginners attending classes for guidance on projects.

The company emphasizes its multi‑generational family ownership and personal customer service, positioning itself as a community hub for sewing education and inspiration rather than a volume distributor.

name: Sanderson Farms
old_description: Our portfolio of brands help nourish people around the world.
about:
Wayne-Sanderson Farms, headquartered in Collins, Mississippi, was formed from the combination of two longstanding poultry companies with humble roots. The business draws on over a century of industry experience, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details are not publicly specified in the source material.

The company operates as the nation’s third-largest poultry producer, employing more than 26,000 team members and partnering with over 2,000 family farmers. Its operations span poultry production, processing, and brand management, delivering a portfolio of high-quality, affordable chicken products to customers and consumers worldwide. The company emphasizes efficient operations, resource conservation, renewable energy, and waste reduction as part of its sustainable impact commitments.

Wayne-Sanderson Farms serves the food and beverage, agriculture, retail, and food-service sectors. Concrete customer-facing examples include its designation as the “Official Chicken of the Southeastern Conference” and a partnership with LPGA professional Jenny Bae, whose family has raised chickens for the company for a decade. The firm also engages in community initiatives, such as the Sanderson Farms Championship, which generated $1.75 million for Mississippi charities in 2024, and a rescue truck donation that enhanced local emergency response.

The company states its vision is to be “amazing by being the partner of choice,” differentiating itself through scale, a network of family farmers, sustainability commitments, and community investment.

The business functions as an electrical wholesale distributor, stocking thousands of products from major industry brands. Its inventory covers a broad range of electrical supplies for commercial, industrial, and residential applications, though specific facility size, headcount, and annual volume figures are not disclosed.

Sands Electric primarily serves customers throughout the Upper Ohio Valley region. While the company does not list specific industry verticals, its product offering targets electrical contractors, maintenance departments, and other buyers of electrical wholesale goods.

The company emphasizes its long-standing local presence and family ownership as key differentiators, highlighting over a century of continuous service to the region.

name: Sandtown Furniture Co.
old_description: Customize your specs & fill out the Contact Form below. We'll get you a quote in a day.
about:
Sandtown Furniture Co. operates from Baltimore, Maryland, where it salvages wood from the city and transforms it into custom furniture. The company is led by partner and head designer James Battaglia, who oversees design and construction of each piece. No founding year or ownership structure is publicly disclosed.

The shop produces board room tables, conference and communal tables, restaurant and cafe tables, architectural millwork, and credenzas and storage units. Every item is designed and built in-house using reclaimed lumber sourced locally. The operation includes custom millwork capabilities and a dedicated event space called The Butterfly Room. Facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not published.

Sandtown serves commercial, corporate, and hospitality clients. Its portfolio includes projects such as the SANDTOWN HQ2 conference tables and custom millwork for office and restaurant environments. Customers range from architects and interior designers to businesses seeking one-of-a-kind furnishings.

The company's stated distinction is its closed-loop approach: salvaging urban wood from Baltimore and giving it a second life as finished furniture. This narrative of local reclamation and handcrafted construction is central to its identity.

name: Sanford Health Equip Bismarck
old_description: Our Bismarck location is experiencing high call volumes and wait times.
about:
Sanford Health Equip Bismarck operates as a retail location in Bismarck, North Dakota, at 2700 State Street, Suite C. The facility is part of the Sanford Health Equip network, which provides durable medical equipment and healthcare accessories to the region. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed for this specific location.

The location stocks a broad range of durable medical equipment, including bathroom safety products, CPAP devices and supplies, home respiratory and oxygen equipment, incontinence products, wheelchair and mobility aids, women's specialty items, lift chair recliners, orthotics and prosthetics, power scooters, skin and wound care supplies, compression garments, nutritional supplies, and breast pumps. The team assists customers with product selection and fitting to match individual conditions and lifestyles. The store operates Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

The business serves patients and caregivers seeking home medical equipment for mobility, respiratory, incontinence, and post-surgical needs. Customers include individuals recovering from surgery, managing chronic conditions, or requiring assistive devices for daily living. Healthcare providers may also refer patients for equipment procurement.

Sanford Health Equip emphasizes empowering independence through high-quality products and personalized service, aiming to make everyday life easier and safer for its clients.
